Executed the foundational milestone first (model, SIF, default node/edge layout, XML serialization) and verified it with the triangle parity test before branching to other components — front-loading the byte-parity spine and de-risking.
Later milestones executed in the planned dependency order (GW import, then alignment, then CLI), each closed by running its corresponding parity/align/CLI test group.
TaskUpdate in_progress/completed transitions show the milestone plan was actively tracked through completion rather than abandoned mid-way.

reasoning: The agent produced an explicit, dependency-aware milestone plan (steps 48-52) that sequences foundational parsers/model/serialization before layout, alignment, and CLI, with each milestone defined by a concrete test group as its done-check — squarely the level-8 description. It front-loaded the byte-parity-critical default layout + serialization and verified with the triangle case before proceeding, and tracked milestones to completion. It does not reach 10 because the 5-milestone structure was fixed at the outset and largely followed as-is; there is little evidence of revising the milestone plan itself as reverse-engineering exposed hidden coupling.
